title: Admin safeguard toggles: tenancy shield, IP gate, and sharing embargo
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Build a tenant-level admin surface and backend enforcement for a new set of compliance toggles. These toggles empower org admins to enforce stricter export and sharing policies without changing app-level code. The feature includes three primary controls: (1) Tenancy Shield Mode (block public sharing, disable anonymous links), (2) IP Gate (allowlist CIDR ranges for API and console access), and (3) Data Egress Embargo (prevent data export or download outside the org boundary). Integrate enforcement with RBAC v2 so only entitled admin roles can flip toggles, and ensure all toggle changes, policy hits, and blocked operations are captured in audit logs. Deliverables: API endpoints for programmatic control, Console UI controls in the Admin > Security page, runtime enforcement hooks for hosted and dedicated serving runtimes, compatibility for Private/VPC deployments, and an observability dashboard for policy events.
acceptance_criteria: Org admins can enable/disable Tenancy Shield Mode via console and REST API
IP Gate accepts multiple CIDR ranges and validates entries; applied to both API traffic and console sessions
Data Egress Embargo prevents export endpoints (CSV/JSON download, file export APIs, workspace exports) from returning payloads when enabled
RBAC v2 entitlements guard toggle access; non-entitled users receive 403 from toggle API
All toggle flips and policy enforcement events are recorded in audit logs with actor, timestamp, before/after state, and trace id
Integration tests demonstrate enforcement in hosted and dedicated environments; private deployment runbook documents differences
Rollout plan with feature flag exists and can be targeted at a single tenant for canary testing

technical_notes: Enforcement points: API gateway (ingress), console server (UI actions), runtime token validator (serve runtime request enrichment)
Storage: new tenant_policies table keyed by org_id with JSONB policy blob and version integer for optimistic concurrency
RBAC: surface a new entitlement 'org:manage_compliance_policies' in RBAC v2; UI hides toggles for users without entitlement
Audit: write audit records to the existing audit_log stream; include correlation_id to link to request traces
Performance: implement CIDR cache and Bloom filter for hot path checks to minimize latency impact on token validation
Private/VPC notes: KMS-encrypted policy store for on-prem; operator-run migrations will apply via upgrade script
Fallback: if the policy service is unreachable, default to deny for enforcement endpoints flagged as strict; make this configurable per-tenant
test_plan: Unit tests for API validation, CIDR parsing, and RBAC entitlement checks
Integration tests that simulate toggle flips and assert UI + API behavior
E2E canary flow: enable toggle in shadow mode for a single tenant; verify logs and no user-facing blockage
Chaos test: simulate policy-store outage and validate deny-by-default behavior and alerting
Load test: measure added latency at 10k req/s with IP Gate enabled and confirm <1% p95 delta
risks: IP checks on hot request path could add measurable latency if not cached properly
Backward compatibility with older API keys that expect legacy export behavior — migration must be seamless
Mistakenly enabling strict enforcement for a high-volume tenant could cause operational incidents; need clear rollback path
Audit volume increase may impact retention/ingest costs; consider sampling or dedicated retention policy
qa_criteria: Console shows current policy state and last modified metadata
API returns 403 with structured error when a blocked action is attempted under an active policy
Audit log entries created for toggle changes and for blocked/allowed policy enforcement events
Metrics emitted: policy_evaluations_total (labels: org_id, policy, result) and policy_blocked_requests_total
Migration completes without downtime for tenants with >100k objects
